claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_damage_type
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The passive magic-weapon rider changes this weapon's hit damage from one type to another, which is neither a numeric modifier nor a standalone damage instance.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you make an attack roll with this magic weapon and hit, you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: AreaShapeDescriptor.line_to_target
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The activation's area is a 5-foot-wide line whose length is the distance from the thrower to the chosen target, capped at 120 feet; the existing line shape only supports a fixed length.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you throw this weapon at a target no farther than 120 feet from you, you can forgo making a ranged attack roll and instead turn the weapon into a bolt of lightning. This bolt forms a 5-foot-wide Line between you and the target.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: return_item_to_hand
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The activation deterministically moves the thrown weapon back to the wielder's hand after damage resolves, and the current surface has no honest item-return effect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Immediately after dealing this damage, the weapon reappears in your hand.
